newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower, Sep/Dec spreading noted.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower, Sep/Dec spreading noted.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower as the choppy trading pattern continued but bull spreading of the September/December again drew attention to the relatively tight cash situation, traders said.
Speculative selling early drove rice sharply lower but commercial buying "brought it back up," a trader said.
Traders said there was strong commercial buying in the September and September/November traded at 10 cents per cwt, premium September.
Rice futures closed two to 13 cents per cwt lower, with September down two at $10.30.
"Cash remains at a premium to the board," a trader said referring to the ability of rice futures to quickly bounce from occasional setbacks.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 350 contracts, down from 436 Friday, according to the CBOT. Rice options volume was estimated at 35 contracts, down from 47 Friday.
